description: Positive flat 9x9 grid with 0.01 m3/s inflow to centre cell, exceeding the dry threshold. Check conservation Q*t, spreading, finite nonnegative depths and exact time coverage before water reaches the boundary; this is an invariant test, not an external hydraulic benchmark. Spreading is required at 2 s; the dry initial state delays the wet-domain update during the first step.
licensing: No third-party data. Repository license is not assigned; this fixture is for the authorized local tests.
time_semantics: Record after the numeric first row: seconds elapsed; mean discharge on the interval ending at that timestamp. No extrapolation after t=2.
tolerance_basis: Numerical storage regression using float32 forcing and text serialization. Tolerances cover rounding, not physical-model error.
limitations: No external reference solution; verifies storage conservation and spreading only.
Does not validate real-basin hydraulics, tide, restart, triangular mesh or mizuRoute handoff.
